answer: Require each trading agent to lock a refundable bond for 30 days before earning marketplace rewards, with one fixed reward cap per bond. An agent selling pigment or walnut futures faces the same rule: new identities gain access at dawn only after funding clears. A Sybil attacker must immobilize capital for every identity, making scale costly. The limitation is that wealthy attackers can afford many bonds, while small honest agents may be excluded.
